newsitem.title: FRANCE: BNP rises on talk of Dresdner link.
newsitem.headline: BNP rises on talk of Dresdner link.

text.p: Shares in Banque Nationale de Paris (BNP) rose on Tuesday, on hopes of a strengthening of ties with Dresdner Bank, market sources said.

They said the market talk was spurred by an interview in a German newspaper given by Dresdner chairman Juergen Sarrazin in which he raised the possibility of closer relations with BNP, with which Dresdner has existing links.

BNP was up 1.22 percent at 231.7 francs on volume of more than 924,000 shares at 1304 GMT, after hitting a day-high of 239.5 francs. Societe Generale was down 1.8 percent at 599, while CCF shed 1.3 percent to 235.9.

"The prospect of a merger with Dresdner is favourable for BNP," said a market operator, who added that the stock had fallen heavily last week and started recovering late on Monday after a soft start with the rest of the market.
